meta.title: Hold a PR line item with a remark; it appears in the Hold tab with who held it

plan.title: Hold PR line item with remark

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions area so the buyer-side PR workflow is available.

args.goal: Open the applicable PR, scroll to the far right, click the 🚫 Hold Item control for a line item that is not already on hold, enter the requested explanatory remark, confirm with the blue Hold Item button, open the Hold status tab, and stop when the held line item and the name of the person who held it are visible.

steps.note: No catalog domain step models holding a PR line, entering its remark, confirming it, or verifying the holder, so perform the complete buyer-side interaction on screen.
Confirm the resulting PR screen visibly contains the Hold status tab.
